purpose: Pinned provenance for the libmpv engine bundled with the Windows build. The Windows CMake configure step reads this file, downloads or reuses the exact artifact, verifies every digest, and bundles the verified libmpv-2.dll instead of the 2023 build shipped by media_kit_libs_windows_video.

engine.versionEvidence: Windows version resource of libmpv-2.dll and the mpv-version property it reports at runtime
engine.describeVersionEvidence: Official stable release tag v0.42.0 of mpv-player/mpv
engine.runtimeVersionEvidence: SemVer form the updater derives from the package asset name; test/bundled_engine_test.dart keeps lib/domain/updates/bundled_engine.dart equal to it
engine.license: GPL-2.0-or-later (upstream ships the GPL version 2 text as LICENSE.GPL, reproduced as packaging/windows/LICENSE.libmpv-GPL.txt). The FFmpeg libraries linked into this build were built with --enable-gpl --enable-version3 and report GPL version 3 or later, so the combined work is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later terms.
engine.runtimeDependencies: Windows system modules only. libmpv-2.dll is a self-contained static build, so it needs no bundled FFmpeg or libass DLLs.

replaces.source: media_kit_libs_windows_video 1.0.11 for Flutter, archive mpv-dev-x86_64-20230924-git-652a1dd.7z from media-kit/libmpv-win32-video-build tag 2023-09-24
replaces.reason: mpv released 0.37.0 and later with security and correctness fixes, and states that old releases do not receive upstream security patches. The 2023 module also carried a stale FFmpeg n6.0 snapshot.

bundledCompanions.note: These are unchanged and still come from media_kit_libs_windows_video. They serve the video renderer's ANGLE path, not the engine. vk_swiftshader.dll is a Vulkan CPU rasterizer fallback not required for Direct3D 11 (d3d11) on Windows 10/11 and is excluded from the installer to save ~4.6 MB.

upstreamFacts: mpv publishes Windows libmpv modules under stable release tags as well as the rolling git-release tag.
Official stable releases (e.g. v0.42.0) provide permanent, verified libmpv artifacts that do not disappear when new commits land.

Tailored desktop libmpv builds (e.g. from zhongfly or shinchiro configured without esoteric scripting tools like VapourSynth/MuJS) range between 28 MB and 40 MB while maintaining full codec support (AV1, HEVC, VP9, H.264) and DXVA2/D3D11VA hardware acceleration, saving >110 MB. They can be supplied via MPVSON_ENGINE_DLL with -DMPVSON_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ENGINE=ON, and stripped using llvm-strip --strip-all.

maintenance.refresh: dart run tool/engine_provenance.dart refresh --accept <version> rewrites this file from upstream release metadata and recomputes every digest. Review the diff before committing.
maintenance.verify: dart run tool/engine_provenance.dart verify checks this record against the cached artifact, the extracted module and the built bundle.
maintenance.inventory: dart run tool/engine_provenance.dart inventory writes build/engine/engine-inventory.json for release provenance.
maintenance.risk: Official stable releases provide permanent asset URLs and immutable artifacts.
